jhj Wan 视频工作流程

有两个工作流程

  • I2V

  • T2V

他们从以下位置加载 GGUF：

  • https://huggingface.co/city96/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P-gguf

  • https://huggingface.co/city96/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-gguf

  • https://huggingface.co/city96/Wan2.1-T2V-14B-gguf

它会加载 GGUF，以便您可以选择与您的 GPU 匹配的正确量化模型。

工作流程首先生成分辨率较小的视频 -> 然后针对 VRAM 的限制进行升级。

如果在升级节点期间遇到 OOM，请绕过工作流中的升级节点并单独进行升级。

如果您有兴趣培训 Wan Video LoRA，请访问：

  • https://github.com/jhj0517/finetuning-notebooks


版本控制在：
https://github.com/jhj0517/ComfyUI-workflows

jhj Wan Video workflows

There're two workflows for

  • I2V

  • T2V

They load GGUF from:

  • https://huggingface.co/city96/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P-gguf

  • https://huggingface.co/city96/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P-gguf

  • https://huggingface.co/city96/Wan2.1-T2V-14B-gguf

It loads GGUF so you can select the correct quantized model that matches your GPU.

The workflows first generates video with smaller resolution -> then upscales for the limits of VRAM.

If you get OOM during the upscale nodes, bypass the upscale nodes in the workflow and do the upscale in the separate.

If you're interested in training Wan Video LoRA, please visit :

  • https://github.com/jhj0517/finetuning-notebooks


The version is controlled in :
https://github.com/jhj0517/ComfyUI-workflows
